back.es: to try (tratar de + infinitive); also to treat, to deal with
back.example: I try to sleep, but I can't. / I'm trying to sleep, but I can't.

note: The hint is needed: "de + verb" rules out probar, and "not intentar" rules out intentar, so the prompt has only one answer and is kept apart from the word's "to treat" and "to be about" cards.
